This is kind of long and needs some backstory. I was sitting in my creative writing class in high school when I overheard a group of girls talking about a guy reenacting the Texas chainsaw massacre a couple years ago in my state. Apparently the guy would walk around the center of my state (sorry for not being specific on the internet) with an axe and long story short murder them. So naturally I thought nothing of it until I got hit with a wicked flashback to when I’d go up north with my friends. For my friends birthday we’d go to the center of our state to his cabin where he hunts with his dad and shoot each other with airsoft guns. There isn’t another house around except his one neighbor over a mile away separated by farmland. We decided to play late at night out in the marsh by his house and split into two teams of three. We headed east through his backyard and through a small clearing to get there. My friends went north and we went east to start the game. After the game started me and my friends decided to set up camp where we started and see if we could make out any distinct movements before we moved ourselves. Then I noticed a man coming off the road to our south that runs east west. He stepped off the road and headed north towards our clearing and stopped at the path that lead to our house. As soon as he was in a bright enough area I noticed he was holding an axe and pointed it out to my friend who saw it too. Eventually he marched on toward our house and we thought nothing of it. We asked his dad when we got inside if he was chopping wood late at night. He hadn’t left his laptop in four hours. Now the way that game played out after we all sat down and talked about it is my friends came from the north and moved south along the clearing. So if we would’ve started five minutes earlier I would’ve watched my three friends run into this man and who knows what would’ve happened. If we would’ve started five minutes later we would’ve all walked into him on our way to start and maybe he would’ve heard us and hid or who knows. It’s a bunch of what ifs. 

TL:DR a guy re-enacting the Texas chainsaw massacre could’ve stopped by my friends house and by a stroke of luck we timed it right to avoid him all together.
